# Derik Bannister — derikbannister.com

> Operator & founder in Oregon. Builds websites, custom software, SEO, Google Ads,
> AI receptionists, CRM/automation, and reputation systems for service businesses
> (roofing, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, and 14 more trades) across every Oregon
> market plus Boise ID, Spokane WA, Vancouver WA, Reno NV, and Redding CA.
> Contact: bannisterderik@gmail.com · call/text 530-736-7085.

## Services
- [Website Design & Development](https://derikbannister.com/services/web-design/): Fast, search-first websites that convert calls
- [Custom Software Development](https://derikbannister.com/services/custom-software/): Purpose-built software for how your operation runs
- [SEO & Local Search](https://derikbannister.com/services/seo/): Map-pack and organic rankings where customers search
- [Google Ads & LSA Management](https://derikbannister.com/services/google-ads/): LSA + PPC run to cost-per-booked-job
- [AI Receptionist & Call Answering](https://derikbannister.com/services/ai-receptionist/): Every call answered 24/7 and booked
- [CRM & Pipeline Automation](https://derikbannister.com/services/crm/): One pipeline, follow-up that never forgets
- [Email & SMS Marketing](https://derikbannister.com/services/email-sms-marketing/): Estimates chased, past customers reactivated
- [Reputation & Review Management](https://derikbannister.com/services/reputation-management/): Reviews requested, answered, defended
- [Content & Blogging](https://derikbannister.com/services/content-marketing/): Local content that compounds into rankings
- [Link Building & Digital PR](https://derikbannister.com/services/link-building/): White-hat authority links that move rankings
- [Press Release Writing & Distribution](https://derikbannister.com/services/press-releases/): Announcements written and distributed properly
- [Brand & Identity](https://derikbannister.com/services/branding/): An identity you can spot from two lanes over
